title: De-identified contact summary
description: A fictional, de-identified summary of one contact handled at a crisis center, for supervisors and training: contact type, duration, category of need and the supervisor action. It never states a method, means or place, never names a person and never presents suicide as a solution. It is marked as a fictional exercise record. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

situation.description: One or two plain sentences about the person's circumstances, with no identifying detail and no method or means
examples: The texter said they were overwhelmed after a recent loss in their community and had little support nearby.

counselorActions.description: What the counselor did, in general terms (listening, exploring supports, safety planning, linking to services)
examples: The counselor listened, explored supports and agreed on a next step with the texter.
Contact ended with a plan to talk with a family member tonight

supervisorNote.description: A supervisor action: consult, debrief or wellbeing check for the counselor
examples: Supervisor offered the counselor a break and a debrief after the contact.

notice.description: The standing notice that the record is fictional
examples: Fictional exercise record. No real person is described.
